about.title: How I work
about.heading: Hi, I’m Filipe.
about.intro: I’m a full-stack developer. Most of my recent work is React and TypeScript on the front-end, C# and SQL on the back-end, and QA in the same delivery cycle — not as a separate phase.
about.bio: I’ve been building and maintaining platforms used by operations and engineering teams: construction SuperApps, omnichannel support, and internal tools. I care about interfaces that hold up in production, APIs that stay integrable, and tests that catch the thing that would have shipped.
